verdict.rationale: Capacities documents official sync: it is offline-first, and changes synchronize once you are back online. A mobile companion app works with the same space as desktop, so cross-device sync is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows end-to-end encryption or a zero-knowledge design that keeps the vendor from reading notes, and that is half of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of end-to-end or zero-knowledge encryption, details of how sync works across devices, independent corroboration of sync reliability.
